description: Message queuing preserves FIFO order. For any sequence of enqueued messages to the same destination, messages are transmitted in the exact order they were enqueued.

preconditions.description: Message queue is initialized and empty
Multiple messages are enqueued to the same destination with sequential timestamps

expectedOutcome.description: Dequeuing messages returns them in FIFO order (earliest queued_at first), with high-priority messages taking precedence

expected.ordering: FIFO by queued_at within same priority, high priority before normal
